title: Draft: ftype-double: Do user friendly float comparison
description:
Comparing float and double does not work most of the times because
they do not represent exact values.

When comparing float values convert the double-precision floating point
value to a single-precision floating point string representation first.
This will compare the same values as being printed, and is probably
what a user will expect.

Ping #16483
